schema.aiMaturity: string — one of: Exploring, Piloting, Scaling, Mature, Unknown
schema.regulations: array of strings — regulatory regimes that apply to this company, e.g. ['EU AI Act', 'DORA', 'GDPR']
schema.existingRelationship: string — none, warm referral, prior conversation, prior client, active client
schema.referredBy: string or null — name of the person or prior client who referred this company, if existingRelationship is 'warm referral' and it's known; null if not a referral or the referrer isn't known. Added per AOS-PRACTICE-VALIDATION-ROADMAP.md's Client Satisfaction KPI (referral rate) — existingRelationship alone can say a company arrived via referral, not who sent them, so 'which past client generates referrals' couldn't be answered without this
schema.recruiter: string or null — recruiter/agency name if this company was reached via one

previousApplications.outcome: string — applied, interview, rejected, withdrawn, offer, hired

schema.tailoredPositioning: string — the angle that fits this company specifically, so it doesn't need to be reasoned out again next time
schema.relationshipTemperature: string — hot, warm, cooling, cold (owned by 04-Sales-Director)

outreachHistory.channel: string — LinkedIn, email, call, referral introduction, event
